name: RC-B10-0110/2026 – § 10 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
part_text: 10. Calls for the EU and its Member States to provide protection and humanitarian assistance to people facing a serious risk to life, including through humanitarian visas, temporary relocation schemes and fair asylum procedures for all Iranian nationals seeking protection in the EU, and to support solutions to restore internet and telecommunications access;
